objective: Probe whether Ibex can be directly instantiated in the repo-owned SoC CPU-kick overlay with the current Verilator flow.

probe.first_blocker: prim_ram_1p_scr imports prim_ram_1p_pkg unless the lowRISC primitive package set is explicitly ordered.
second_blocker_after_adding_prim_ram_1p_: prim_count uses action_mask_t from prim_count_pkg and needs package ordering compatible with direct Verilator invocation

decision.reason: The repo-owned overlay boundary is ready, but direct Ibex instantiation needs a narrow lowRISC primitive dependency/file-order gate before wiring the CPU into the LLM proxy.

next_required_gate.name: llm_soc_ibex_lowrisc_primitive_dependency_gate
must_define: minimal lowRISC primitive package/source list required by ibex_top with ICache=0 and SecureIbex=0
include directories for prim_assert.sv and dv_fcov_macros.svh
whether to instantiate ibex_top or ibex_core plus repo-owned register file/memory stubs
warning policy for vendored primitive RTL
do not copy vendored primitive files into overlays/
